title: Biological Omega threats, laboratory control surfaces, and answerable power
selection_rule: Apply the same predicates, source routes, temporal rules, privacy controls, and evidentiary burdens to the declared universe regardless of political salience, institution, country, suspected origin, research field, funding source, or anticipated conclusion. A famous laboratory, contested outbreak, or named actor may route discovery but cannot define membership.
standing_forbidden_inferences: biosafety level proves actual risk or compliance
committee membership proves knowledge or veto authority
sequence or customer flag proves malicious intent
absence of public incident reporting proves absence of incidents
natural emergence evidence excludes accident or deliberate origin without sufficient evidence
broad institution creates a Clifford hop
co-presence proves contact, influence, agreement, or wrongdoing

source_families: primary public institutional and provider records
explicit null, unavailable, disputed, and correction records
common_case_contract.security_boundary: No pathogen-design instructions, sequence data, enhancement targets, laboratory exploit details, facility vulnerabilities, patient records, or operational targeting information may enter the public programme.

cases.title: Natural emergence and zoonotic spillover
cases.public_interest_question: Which source-complete human-animal-environment surveillance surfaces detect a novel high-consequence event early enough to change containment?
cases.selection_unit: one named surveillance programme, signal, investigation, or exercise
cases.selection_universe: declared One Health surveillance and outbreak-investigation source families for a fixed jurisdiction and period
cases.acceptance: A reproducible denominator, dated bounded-surface ledger, receipts, evidence ceilings, control-owner and answerable-power map, negative and ordinary controls, security review, and an outcome that may be positive, negative, inconclusive, inadmissible, or unresolved.

review.required: independent biosafety, biosecurity, public-health, legal, privacy, and Clifford-method review
review.promotion_path: Freeze each denominator and safe source plan, acquire receipts, conduct security and privacy review, preserve nulls and contradictory evidence, then promote only bounded objects through the ordinary Clifford contribution pipeline.
review.cross_case_rule: Cross-case recurrence or topology may be computed only after every contributing case independently establishes its universe, evidence state, temporal boundary, security treatment, and refusal conditions.
